name: popover
summary: A small floating panel anchored to a control, for a few related choices or a short form without leaving the page.
useWhen: A setting chip opens its options right where it sits, such as duration or batch size.
A short piece of extra detail needs room for a heading and a control.

alternatives.name: dropdown-menu
alternatives.when: the content is a list of actions or a single choice from a list

alternatives.name: dialog
alternatives.when: the task needs focus and blocks the page until it is answered

alternatives.name: tooltip
alternatives.when: it only names an icon and holds nothing interactive

rules.do: Keep a popover to one short task, such as picking a duration, with a few controls.
rules.dont: Build a whole settings page inside a popover. Long content scrolls awkwardly and closes on any outside click.

rules.do: Open the popover from the control it changes, so the link between them is obvious.
rules.dont: Open a popover from one place to change something elsewhere on the page.

a11y: Focus moves into the popover when it opens and returns to the trigger when it closes.
Escape and an outside click close it.
